title: Control Multiple AI Coders Easily
description:
Link to the Resource Vault: https://thenextnewthing.ai/Resources
(There is also a clickable link in my bio)

Link to the full video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FHenFUT_uC0 

Managing multiple AI coding agents in your terminal usually means drowning in confusing windows and wall-to-wall text. The Herdr repo solves this overnight by letting you control an entire herd of parallel coding agents directly from a single, clean terminal interface.

Instead of sacrificing the power of terminal-first features for bloated VS Code extensions, Herdr brings visual tab management and real-time status tracking straight to your command line. You get to run parallel agents, monitor project progress, and ship code faster without losing track of your workflow.
